blocks.en: Regulatory Background

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解預充填注射器 (PFS) 在歐盟 MDR 框架下作為藥械組合產品 (DDC) 的法規分類
blocks.en: Understand the regulatory classification of the prefilled syringe (PFS) as a drug-device combination product (DDC) under the EU MDR framework

blocks.zh: 掌握 MDR Annex I 一般安全與效能要求 (GSPR) 對預充填注射器器械部分的適用性
blocks.en: Grasp the applicability of the MDR Annex I General Safety and Performance Requirements (GSPRs) to the device part of a prefilled syringe

blocks.zh: 了解 Notified Body Opinion (NBOp) 的必要性與觸發條件
blocks.en: Understand why a Notified Body Opinion (NBOp) is needed and what triggers it

blocks.zh: 認識申請人在資料生成與提交中的最終責任，以及 ALCOA 原則的應用
blocks.en: Recognize the applicant's ultimate responsibility for data generation and submission, and the application of the ALCOA principles

blocks.zh: 3.0 Regulatory Background 3.0 法規背景
blocks.en: 3.0 Regulatory Background

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: DDC (Drug-Device Combination, 藥械組合產品): 預充填注射器是一種「單一整合」的藥械組合產品。藥品與器械不可分離——針頭已經固定在注射筒上（staked needle），使用者拿到的是一個完整的產品。這意味著它同時受到藥品法規與醫療器材法規的雙重管轄。
blocks.en: DDC (Drug-Device Combination): A prefilled syringe is a "single integral" drug-device combination product. The drug and the device cannot be separated: the needle is already fixed to the syringe barrel (staked needle), and the user receives one complete product. This means it is subject to both medicinal product regulation and medical device regulation.

blocks.zh: GSPR (General Safety and Performance Requirements, 一般安全與效能要求): 這是 MDR Annex I 中規定的核心要求清單，涵蓋了醫療器材在設計、製造、標示等面向必須滿足的安全與效能標準。對於 PFS 的器械部分，必須逐條評估每項 GSPR 是否適用，並提供符合性證據。
blocks.en: GSPR (General Safety and Performance Requirements): The core list of requirements set out in MDR Annex I, covering the safety and performance standards a medical device must meet in design, manufacture, labeling and other respects. For the device part of a PFS, each GSPR must be assessed for applicability, and evidence of compliance must be provided.

blocks.zh: NBOp (Notified Body Opinion, 驗證機構意見): 由歐盟指定的驗證機構 (Notified Body) 對器械部分進行符合性評估後出具的正式意見。這不是一張「認證」，而是一份供主管機關在審查上市許可申請時參考的專業評估報告。
blocks.en: NBOp (Notified Body Opinion): A formal opinion issued by an EU-designated Notified Body after it assesses the conformity of the device part. It is not a "certificate"; it is a professional assessment report that the competent authority refers to when reviewing the marketing authorisation application.

blocks.zh: Virtual Device (虛擬器材): PFS 的器械部分在法規上並不作為獨立的醫療器材上市，但仍需按照 MDR 分類規則進行「虛擬分類」，以確定所需的符合性評估深度。這是一個獨特的法規概念——產品不存在獨立的器材上市許可，卻仍需經過器材法規的審查程序。
blocks.en: Virtual Device: The device part of a PFS is not placed on the market as a stand-alone medical device, but it still has to be "virtually classified" under the MDR classification rules to determine the depth of conformity assessment required. This is a unique regulatory concept: there is no separate device marketing authorisation for the product, yet it still goes through the device regulation review process.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你經營一家餐廳，推出一道「套餐」（藥械組合產品）。這道套餐包含食物（藥品）和特製餐具（器材部分）。衛生局（主管機關）要求你不僅要確保食物安全（藥品品質），還要證明你的特製餐具符合餐具安全標準（GSPR）。由於這餐具是刀叉一體的特殊設計（Class IIa），你不能自己說「我覺得安全」——你必須請一個獨立的餐具檢驗機構（Notified Body）出具檢驗報告（NBOp），然後連同你的食品安全文件一起提交給衛生局。最終，整份套餐的所有品質責任都在你（申請人）身上。
blocks.en: Imagine you run a restaurant and launch a "set meal" (the drug-device combination product). The set includes food (the drug) and a specially designed utensil (the device part). The health department (the competent authority) requires you not only to ensure the food is safe (drug quality) but also to prove that your special utensil meets utensil safety standards (the GSPRs). Because the utensil is a special knife-and-fork combined design (Class IIa), you cannot simply say "I think it is safe": you must have an independent utensil inspection body (the Notified Body) issue an inspection report (the NBOp), and submit it to the health department together with your food safety documents. In the end, all responsibility for the quality of the entire set meal rests with you (the applicant).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: Class IIa 分類的關鍵邏輯：MDR Annex VIII Rule 6 針對的是「暫時使用的外科侵入性器材」。預充填注射器的針頭會穿刺皮膚進入人體（外科侵入性），使用時間極短（暫時使用），因此歸類為 Class IIa 或更高。一旦達到 Class IIa，就不能僅靠製造商自行宣告符合性——必須有 Notified Body 的參與。
blocks.en: The key logic of the Class IIa classification: MDR Annex VIII Rule 6 addresses "surgically invasive devices intended for transient use". The needle of a prefilled syringe penetrates the skin and enters the body (surgically invasive) and is used for a very short time (transient use), so it is classified as Class IIa or higher. Once a device reaches Class IIa, the manufacturer cannot rely on a self-declaration of conformity alone; a Notified Body must be involved.

blocks.zh: ALCOA 原則不可妥協：所有提交的數據必須符合 ALCOA 原則——可歸因 (Attributable)、清晰可讀 (Legible)、與事件同步記錄 (Contemporaneous)、原始 (Original)、準確 (Accurate)。這是數據完整性的基石，也是 EMA 在 GMP 和數據完整性方面反覆強調的要求。
blocks.en: The ALCOA principles are non-negotiable: All submitted data must comply with the ALCOA principles: Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate. This is the cornerstone of data integrity and a requirement the EMA repeatedly emphasizes in relation to GMP and data integrity.

blocks.zh: 責任歸屬明確：雖然數據的產生是元件製造商、器材組裝商與製藥公司的共同努力，但最終責任在申請人（製藥公司）身上。這意味著製藥公司不能只是「轉交」供應商提供的數據，而必須確保所有數據的品質與完整性。
blocks.en: Clear allocation of responsibility: Although data generation is a joint effort of the component manufacturer, the device assembler and the pharmaceutical company, the ultimate responsibility lies with the applicant (the pharmaceutical company). This means the pharmaceutical company cannot simply "pass on" the data provided by suppliers; it must ensure the quality and integrity of all data.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 的角色定位：作為 CDMO，你可能同時扮演「器材部分製造商」和「藥品充填商」的角色。當客戶（製藥公司）準備向歐盟申請上市許可時，你需要：
blocks.en: Positioning the role of a CDMO: As a CDMO, you may act as both the "device part manufacturer" and the "drug product filler". When your client (the pharmaceutical company) prepares to apply for marketing authorisation in the EU, you will need to:

blocks.zh: 提供注射器組裝和充填過程中的製程驗證數據
blocks.en: Provide process validation data for the syringe assembly and filling processes

blocks.zh: 確保所有測試報告符合 ALCOA 原則
blocks.en: Ensure that all test reports comply with the ALCOA principles

blocks.zh: 配合客戶準備 Notified Body 的提交文件
blocks.en: Support the client in preparing the Notified Body submission

blocks.zh: 了解哪些 GSPR 與你的製造步驟相關，並準備對應的符合性證據
blocks.en: Understand which GSPRs are relevant to your manufacturing steps and prepare the corresponding evidence of compliance

blocks.zh: 即使最終責任在客戶（申請人）身上，數據品質問題會直接影響 NBOp 的取得，進而延誤產品上市時程。
blocks.en: Even though the ultimate responsibility lies with the client (the applicant), data quality problems directly affect whether the NBOp is obtained and therefore delay time to market.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼預充填注射器的器械部分被稱為「虛擬器材」(virtual device)？它與一般獨立上市的醫療器材有什麼不同？
blocks.en: Why is the device part of a prefilled syringe called a "virtual device"? How does it differ from a medical device that is placed on the market on its own?

blocks.zh: 如果一個預充填注射器的針頭設計改變（例如從 27G 改為 29G），是否需要重新取得 NBOp？為什麼？
blocks.en: If the needle design of a prefilled syringe changes (for example, from 27G to 29G), does a new NBOp need to be obtained? Why?

blocks.zh: 製藥公司可以僅提交元件供應商的原始測試報告給 Notified Body 嗎？根據 ALCOA 原則，申請人還需要做什麼？
blocks.en: Can a pharmaceutical company submit only the component supplier's original test reports to the Notified Body? According to the ALCOA principles, what else must the applicant do?

blocks.zh: MDR Article 117 修訂了 Directive 2001/83/EC 的哪一部分？這項修訂的實質意義是什麼？
blocks.en: Which part of Directive 2001/83/EC was amended by MDR Article 117? What is the practical significance of this amendment?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 預充填固定針注射器 (staked needle PFS) 作為 DDC 產品，其器械部分必須符合 MDR Annex I 的 GSPR 要求
blocks.en: As a DDC product, the device part of a staked needle PFS must meet the GSPR requirements of MDR Annex I

blocks.zh: 器械部分需依 MDR Annex VIII 進行「虛擬分類」——依 Rule 6（暫時使用的外科侵入性器材）歸類為 Class IIa 或更高
blocks.en: The device part must be "virtually classified" under MDR Annex VIII: under Rule 6 (surgically invasive devices for transient use) it is classified as Class IIa or higher

blocks.zh: Class IIa 以上的分類要求 Notified Body 參與符合性評估，並出具 NBOp
blocks.en: Classification as Class IIa or above requires the Notified Body to take part in the conformity assessment and issue an NBOp

blocks.zh: NBOp 必須納入向國家主管機關或 EMA 提交的上市許可申請文件中
blocks.en: The NBOp must be included in the marketing authorisation application submitted to the national competent authority or the EMA

blocks.zh: 數據生成是多方合作（元件商、器材商、製藥公司），但申請人對所有數據的 ALCOA 合規性負最終責任
blocks.en: Data generation is a collaboration among several parties (component supplier, device manufacturer, pharmaceutical company), but the applicant bears ultimate responsibility for ALCOA compliance of all data
